rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP, then retrieved multiple order details, but proceeded to perform several order-changing writes—cancel_pending_order(#W9373487), modify_pending_order_items on #W5481803, and return_delivered_order_items on #W7449508—without first confirming each action with the user, violating the policy. The user also requested the tracking number and help with refund/reorder for the lost tablet; there is no evidence the agent provided a tracking number or addressed refund/reorder beyond performing other changes. The agent also ignored the user’s preference to handle one thing at a time, executing multiple actions in one go, and ended with a generic closing rather than clear final information. While the agent did act on the user’s orders after a basic authentication step, the lack of confirmation before writes and missing fulfillment of the tracking/refund request means the task was not completed in line with policy.
